mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tag WHERE normalized = #{normalized} LIMIT 1
SELECT t.* FROM tag_alias a JOIN tag t ON t.id = a.tag_id WHERE a.normalized = #{normalized} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag(name, category_id, description, normalized, usage_count, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{description}, #{normalized}, COALESCE(#{usageCount}, 0), #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tag SET usage_count = usage_count + 1 WHERE id = #{tagId}
mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO knowledge_tag(knowledge_id, tag_id, match_score, match_layer) VALUES (#{knowledgeId}, #{tagId}, 1.0, 'EXACT')
